notes: «قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخرون، حدثنا عبد الله بن إدريس»: Ishaq and the others share the name of Ibn Idris, so one route. «قال إسحاق» repeats the same man.
«قال قلت لعمر بن الخطاب»: Yaʿla got the report from Umar, so Umar is a link (rule 5). Umar speaks inside the story («فقال عجبت»), so he is the last link (rule 6).
The Prophet is the end; the quoted saying is his.
